projection.title: Oracle Database
projection.description: Oracle cockpit with schemas, tables, views, procedures, packages, sequences, users, tablespaces, sessions, SQL editor, DDL helpers, and safety controls.

fields.label: SID
fields.help: Optional SID. When set it is used instead of service name.

fields.label: Stored password
fields.help: Reusable Oracle password. The credential identity can also supply the username.

fields.label: Client certificate
fields.help: Reusable client certificate and private key used for TCPS external authentication.

fields.label: DBA privilege
fields.help: Only use privileged modes for dedicated administrative connections.

fields.label: CA certificate
fields.help: PEM CA bundle used for verify-ca and verify-full.

fields.label: Client certificate
fields.help: Optional PEM containing the client certificate and private key for TCPS client authentication.

fields.label: Read-only mode
fields.help: Blocks INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, MERGE, PL/SQL blocks, DDL, TRUNCATE, GRANT, and other write statements.

fields.label: Confirm destructive statements
fields.help: Requires explicit confirmation before write, DDL, PL/SQL, and privileged statements execute.

fields.label: Redacted columns
fields.help: Comma or newline separated regular expressions for result columns that must be masked.

actions.label: Create schema
actions.confirmText: Create this schema user? It can own objects and may receive database privileges.

actions.label: Drop schema
actions.confirmText: Drop this schema (user)? The user and every object it owns are permanently deleted.

actions.label: Drop column
actions.confirmText: Drop this column? Its data is permanently removed.

fields.label: Columns
fields.help: Required for primary key, unique, and foreign key.

fields.label: Check expression
fields.help: e.g. AGE >= 0. Required for a CHECK constraint.

fields.label: Referenced table
fields.help: Foreign key only: target table (optionally OWNER.TABLE).

fields.label: Referenced columns
fields.help: Foreign key only: comma-separated columns in the referenced table.

actions.label: Truncate
actions.confirmText: Truncate this table? Every row will be deleted.

actions.label: Drop
actions.confirmText: Drop this table? The table definition and data will be permanently deleted.

actions.label: Kill session
actions.confirmText: Kill this session? In-flight work is rolled back and the connection is terminated immediately.

actions.label: Grant roles/privileges
actions.confirmText: Grant roles or privileges to this user? This can expand access across schemas, objects, or administrative operations.

fields.label: Roles / privileges
fields.help: Each entry is a role or system privilege granted to the user.

actions.label: Drop user
actions.confirmText: Drop this user? The user and every object it owns are permanently deleted.
